title: A porous flower-like boron and nitrogen co-doped diamond film electrode for the enhanced detection of copper ions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1143-1150
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08656F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Meixuan Li, Mingchao Yang, Xiaoxi Yuan, Chunjiang Li, Feng Yang, Dan Yu
In this study, a new sensor of porous flower-like boron and nitrogen co-doped diamond (PFBND) was successfully manufactured for the enhanced detection of copper ionswithout using a mask or reactive ion etching.
